## What's Changed

### Added

- 🚀 **model**: Add MH-PatchCore by @NickF93 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3809
- 🚀 **model**: Add RAD (Retrieval-based Anomaly Detection) model by @josselinonduty in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3721
- 🚀 **model**: Add FoundAD Few Shot Anomaly Detection Model by @rajeshgangireddy in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3793

### Removed

- ⚠️ **breaking**: Remove APIs scheduled for 2.7.0 — legacy ONNX exporter (`dynamo=False`; dynamo/`onnxscript` via `anomalib[openvino]` now required), `restore_frozen_encoder_weights` / pre-timm ViT checkpoint migration (retrain or re-export), and raise minimum PyTorch to `>=2.10.0` (`torchvision>=0.25.0` for cpu/cu/xpu; ROCm remains `torch>=2.13.0`) by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3826

### Changed

- ⚠️ **security**: When a dataset `root` is set, metadata path columns (Tabular and similar loaders) must resolve under that root; absolute paths outside `root` are rejected by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3794 and https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3796
- 🔧 **model**: Replace Sklearn with optimized PyTorch KMeans in CFA by @andersendsa in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3760
- 🔧 **deps**: Require `transformers>=4.40` to avoid resolver backtracking to 4.12 by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3840


### Fixed

- 🐞 **metric**: `AUPR` now computes step-wise average precision, so constant, all-zero and inverted detectors score at the anomaly rate instead of 0.525 by @mateenali66 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3797
- 🐞 **metric**: Fix `thresholds_between_min_and_max` device fallback when `device` is `None` by @andersendsa in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3807
- 🐞 **callbacks**: Make `MaxStepsProgressCallback` picklable during checkpointing by @jrusbo in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3799
- 🐞 **model**: Fix SuperADD's asynchronous CPU copy corrupting stored embeddings by @rajeshgangireddy in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3827
- 🐞 **model**: Make models exportable with the dynamo ONNX exporter by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3834
- 🐞 **model**: Decode CFlow rows in one pass when exporting by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3836
- 🔒 **deps**: Upgrade the ROCm installation extra to PyTorch 2.13 or later on ROCm 7.2 by @AlexanderBarabanov in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3820
- 🔒 **security**: Checkpoint loading now defaults to `weights_only=True`, blocking arbitrary code execution from untrusted `.ckpt`. Checkpoints saved before this change that pickled live component objects in `hyper_parameters` will fail to load; pass `weights_only=False` once to migrate, or re-save under the new format. Custom `PreProcessor` subclasses and non-default `Evaluator` / `Visualizer` instances are not reconstructed automatically — pass them to `load_from_checkpoint(...)` (and override `checkpoint_config` / `load_checkpoint_config` for custom pre/post-processors) by @ashwinvaidya17 in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3801
- 📚 **docs**: remove retired HPO references from README and how-to index by @kuotunyu in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3808


## New Contributors
* @NickF93 made their first contribution in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3809
* @josselinonduty made their first contribution in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3721
* @kuotunyu made their first contribution in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3808
* @jrusbo made their first contribution in https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/pull/3799

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-edge-platform/anomalib/compare/lib/v2.6.2...lib/v2.7.0

---

## API Changes

v2.7.0 removes the legacy ONNX exporter and pre-timm ViT checkpoint migration, raises the minimum PyTorch version, and changes several security-sensitive defaults. New models: `MHPatchcore`, `Rad`, and `FoundAD`.

### At a glance

| Kind | Change | What to do |
|------|--------|------------|
| Removed | Legacy ONNX exporter (`dynamo=False`) | Use `dynamo=True` (default); install `anomalib[openvino]` for `onnxscript` |
| Removed | `restore_frozen_encoder_weights` / pre-timm ViT checkpoint loading | Retrain or re-export under a current release |
| Removed | PyTorch `<2.10` on cpu/cu/xpu extras | Upgrade to `torch>=2.10.0` (ROCm: `>=2.13.0`) |
| Changed | Checkpoint load defaults to `weights_only=True` | Migrate old checkpoints once with `weights_only=False`, or pass custom components into `load_from_checkpoint` |
| Changed | Dataset `root` path hardening | Ensure metadata paths resolve under `root` |
| Changed | `AUPR` scoring | Expect step-wise average precision (edge-case scores may change) |
| Added | `MHPatchcore` | `from anomalib.models import MHPatchcore` |
| Added | `Rad` | `from anomalib.models import Rad` |
| Added | `FoundAD` | `from anomalib.models import FoundAD` |

### Removed

#### Legacy ONNX exporter (`dynamo=False`)

- **Module:** `anomalib.models.components.base.export_mixin`
- **Deprecated since:** v2.5.1
- **Why:** Torch’s dynamo-based exporter is required; the legacy path was removed in v2.7.0.

```python
# Before (no longer works)
model.to_onnx(export_root="./exports", dynamo=False)

# After (default)
# pip install "anomalib[openvino]"  # provides onnxscript
model.to_onnx(export_root="./exports")  # dynamo=True
# or explicitly:
model.to_onnx(export_root="./exports", dynamo=True)
```

#### Pre-timm ViT checkpoint migration (`restore_frozen_encoder_weights`)

- **Module:** previously `anomalib.models.components.base.restore_frozen_encoder_weights`
- **Deprecated since:** v2.5.0
- **Why:** Loading Vision Transformer checkpoints trained before the timm-encoder migration is no longer supported.

```python
# Before: dinomaly / inp_former / anomaly_dino / patchflow / l2bt
# automatically rewrote legacy encoder keys in on_load_checkpoint

# After: retrain, or export/re-save a checkpoint under anomalib >= 2.5
# with the timm-based encoder layout, then load that checkpoint
```

#### Minimum PyTorch `>=2.10.0`

- **Module:** install extras (`cpu`, `cu126`, `cu130`, `xpu`); ROCm remains `torch>=2.13.0`
- **Why:** Announced with the ONNX dynamo deprecation; required for the dynamo exporter path.

```bash
# Before
pip install "anomalib[cpu]"   # allowed torch>=2.6

# After
pip install "anomalib[cpu]"   # requires torch>=2.10, torchvision>=0.25
# ROCm
pip install "anomalib[rocm]"  # requires torch>=2.13
```

### Changed

#### Checkpoint loading defaults to `weights_only=True`

- **Impact:** Untrusted `.ckpt` files can no longer execute arbitrary code via pickle. Checkpoints that pickled live component objects in `hyper_parameters` fail to load until migrated. Custom `PreProcessor` subclasses and non-default `Evaluator` / `Visualizer` instances are not reconstructed automatically.
- **PR:** #3801

```python
# Migrate an old checkpoint once (trusted file only), then re-save
model = MyModel.load_from_checkpoint("old.ckpt", weights_only=False)
# ... or pass custom components explicitly:
model = MyModel.load_from_checkpoint(
    "model.ckpt",
    pre_processor=MyPreProcessor(),
    evaluator=my_evaluator,
    visualizer=my_visualizer,
)
```

#### Dataset `root` path hardening

- **Impact:** When a dataset `root` is set, metadata path columns (Tabular and similar loaders) must resolve under that root; absolute paths outside `root` are rejected.
- **PR:** #3794, #3796

```python
# Paths in metadata must stay under root
datamodule = Tabular(
    name="custom",
    samples=samples,  # path columns relative to / under root
    root="./datasets/custom",
)
```

#### `AUPR` uses step-wise average precision

- **Impact:** Constant, all-zero, and inverted detectors score at the anomaly rate instead of a misleading mid-range value (previously ~0.525 in some cases).
- **PR:** #3797

### Added

#### `MHPatchcore`

- **Import:** `from anomalib.models import MHPatchcore`
- **PR:** #3809

```python
from anomalib.data import MVTecAD
from anomalib.engine import Engine
from anomalib.models import MHPatchcore

datamodule = MVTecAD()
model = MHPatchcore()
engine = Engine()
engine.fit(model=model, datamodule=datamodule)
```

#### `Rad`

- **Import:** `from anomalib.models import Rad`
- **PR:** #3721

```python
from anomalib.data import MVTecAD
from anomalib.engine import Engine
from anomalib.models import Rad

datamodule = MVTecAD()
model = Rad()
engine = Engine()
engine.fit(model=model, datamodule=datamodule)
```

#### `FoundAD`

- **Import:** `from anomalib.models import FoundAD`
- **PR:** #3793

```python
from anomalib.data import MVTecAD
from anomalib.engine import Engine
from anomalib.models import FoundAD

datamodule = MVTecAD()
model = FoundAD()
engine = Engine()
engine.fit(model=model, datamodule=datamodule)
```

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
Release **8.4.174** fixes AutoBatch’s backward-pass profiling for YOLO26 and speeds up prediction summaries, alongside improvements to exports, inference, tracking, and data handling.

## 📊 Key Changes
- **AutoBatch profiling — the main change:** The profiler now finds tensors inside nested model outputs, so backward profiling works with YOLO26 detection heads and other task heads. Prediction summaries also avoid unnecessary tensor conversions, making their logs faster.
- **More reliable inference and exports:** Dynamic CoreML models can handle batches larger than their exported batch size by processing them in chunks. Hailo INT8 optimization now receives reusable calibration images, fixing calibration methods that need to revisit the data.
- **Correct edge-case behavior:** Fast-NMS now keeps detections when the IoU threshold is zero. Tracking hides unconfirmed tracks when appropriate without dropping first-frame detections. INT8 calibration warnings are limited to export formats that support calibration data.
- **Improved data handling:** Dataset splitting preserves the caller’s random state, DOTA splitting accepts images without label files, and image loading and shape calculations better handle EXIF rotations and Unicode paths. Saved crops also retain dotted source names.
- **More dependable model setup:** Predictors and trackers are rebuilt when relevant setup arguments change; model-format detection handles compound filenames more reliably. YouTube inputs no longer require a stream of at least 1080p.
- **Documentation and packaging updates:** Guides cover per-object depth estimates and newer Platform workflows, including image search and live-camera inference. Docker images can cache Python bytecode, while CI and Conda guidance were updated for more compatible dependency resolution.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- **AutoBatch can now measure YOLO26 training memory more accurately.** Because backward profiling runs successfully, automatic batch-size selections may change; fixed-batch training and prediction are unaffected.
- **Exported models are more practical across deployment targets.** CoreML handles larger prediction batches, and Hailo calibration methods that revisit their input data can work as intended.
- **Predictions and datasets are more consistent in edge cases,** reducing unexpected missing detections, failed dataset splits, or crop files that are hard to match to their sources.
- **No model architecture, checkpoint, or default changes are introduced.**

## What's Changed
* Fix misleading INT8 calibration warning for CoreML and MNN by @amanharshx in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26528
* Fix zero-threshold OBB suppression in Fast-NMS by @aswanth-07 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26522
* Fix model.track leaking unconfirmed detections when no tracks are active by @wizzseen in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26525
* Keep dotted image and video names in `save_crop` file names by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26524
* Document per-object depth with instance segmentation by @Vaishnavi220506 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26521
* Revert "Fix model.track leaking unconfirmed detections when no tracks are active" (#26525) by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26532
* Add YOLO26 Depth benchmarks to AMD documentation by @lakshanthad in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26518
* Restore nyu-depth.yaml to the PNG depth standard by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26535
* Let Docker images cache Python bytecode and install with uv everywhere by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26533
* Keep non-synset class names and sub-1080p YouTube streams by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26536
* Solve conda Python and Ultralytics together in CI and docs by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26542
* Pin AMD GPU CI to the ROCm 10.0.0 torch wheels that match the MIGraphX packages by @onuralpszr in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26550
* Treat images without a label file as backgrounds in split_dota by @MohammadHijjawi97 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26539
* Preserve caller random state during autosplit by @Vaishnavi220506 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26548
* Fix model.track unconfirmed leak without clearing first-frame dets by @wizzseen in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26543
* Sync docs with explore image search, live camera inference and class-name matching by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26538
* Rebuild the predictor and persisted trackers when their arguments change by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26541
* Fix dynamic CoreML inference above the export batch limit by @amanharshx in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26551
* Use rounded letterbox size for per-axis gains in `scale_boxes` and `scale_coords` by @MaverickTopG in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26546
* fix: materialize Hailo calibration set before optimization by @nivosco in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26544
* Detect model format from the terminal file suffix by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26549
* Cache EXIF-rotated image shapes as imread decodes them by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26545
* `ultralytics 8.4.174` Fix AutoBatch backward profiling for YOLO26 and speed up prediction logs by @aswanth-07 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26547
